_meta.sourceDir: a clean local build (empty output dir, 693 pages written over 5s)
notes: Set per metric by which direction each check fails in, because a local Windows build and the CI Linux build disagree on 'pages' (693 vs 1270) for reasons not yet understood.
pages / callouts / images / internalLinks fail on a DROP over 5%, so the LOWER of the two builds is the safe ceiling - these come from the local build.
brokenInternalLinks fails on ANY RISE, so the HIGHER of the two is safe: 87 from the CI log (F58), not the local build's 85. Setting 85 would turn CI red the moment it reported 87.
Before changing any number here, read F58 in the vault backlog and check a CI run log.
